findings.issue: After `qwik build` failed on lint in turn 53, the build script was rewritten to `vite build` chains that skip Qwik's lint and `build.types`, and a known TypeScript error in MoveTables was explicitly left in (turn 47: 'build not typecheck? Fine').
findings.suggestion: Either add the starter's eslint.config.js and fix the reported type errors, or run `tsc --noEmit` once before declaring done so the checked-in build doesn't silently hide type regressions.

findings.issue: Roughly ten turns spent reverse-engineering the node-server adapter from node_modules internals (failed `qwik add`, empty `npm pack`, repeated greps) with zero use of web_search/web_fetch despite the SPEC offering it.
findings.suggestion: When a framework integration doesn't work out of the box, check the official deployment docs first (qwik.dev/docs/deployments/#node) and fall back to node_modules archaeology only if the docs are stale.

findings.issue: The first pagination fix guessed that `preventdefault:click` would let the anchor navigate natively; it actually suppresses navigation, costing a failed test run (turns 42/59).
findings.suggestion: When uncertain about a Qwik event attribute's semantics, read the optimizer source or docs before committing the edit rather than testing the guess through the suite.

findings.issue: Controlled `<select value=...>` on SSR'd Qwik markup silently doesn't select an option until hydration, which two tests had to catch (turns 56-58).
findings.suggestion: For SSR'd selects, set `selected` on the options from the start — the same class of bug appears in three places (type, generation, game) and each is a live regression risk if any route is rendered without JS.

findings.issue: Comparison against design/screenshots identified a layout difference on the type page's damage-relations panel, which was noted and then deliberately left unfixed.
findings.suggestion: Either fix the identified diff or record the reason for leaving it, so a reviewer doesn't rediscover it; 'close enough' visual calls deserve an explicit trade-off.

findings.issue: Starter package.json was copied without its companion eslint.config.js, so the first production build failed.
findings.suggestion: Copy starter config files as a matched set (package.json + eslint.config.js + tsconfig) before the first build attempt.

findings.issue: 212 MB of node_modules and build artifacts were left in app/ until an app/.gitignore was finally added at turn 70.
findings.suggestion: Add the ignore file when the scaffold is first created rather than at cleanup time.

summary: A disciplined, near-monotonic session: it read the spec, tests, overlay and screenshots before coding, settled the architecture once, and reached 51/54 on its first full test run and 54/54 two small fix cycles later. Verification went well beyond the suite, with browser screenshots compared against the reference designs and a dist inspection confirming no build-time data was embedded. The main criticisms are that it rewrote the build to bypass lint/typecheck rather than fixing the type errors, and that a framework-integration question was answered by ~10 turns of node_modules archaeology instead of a documentation search.
